limits: The reviewed camera producer expects dev.fieldlog.generatedr90 and rebuilds and re-signs the packaged native material using a disposable root. It cannot attest the immutable .calculation APK identities.

Observed effective permissions are identical. The reviewed camera encoding includes decoded compiled manifest and does not match either exact descriptor's permission pin, which comes from the calculation recipe's source manifest.

The stock inspector requires distinct signed Wasm, an exact source map and offer-bound persisted confirmation evidence. The calculation replay establishes sequence/refusal/recovery and percentage presentation. It cannot substitute for that inspector evidence.

replay.build: From git archive at publicMain, swift build --force-resolved-versions --product mixer (cli) and --product mixer-update (updates) with private scratch and pinned dependencies. Run android-packaging/build-guests.sh CALC_DIR PRIVATE_WORK with its pinned Swift toolchain.
replay.packet: Verify the approved handoff inventory and APK v3 signatures with shasum, apksigner and zipalign. Compare AAPT2 dump permissions and xmltree on both APKs.
replay.inspect: Run mixer release inspect on the original camera review-source. For negative controls create the stock pair.25 project for dev.fieldlog.generatedr90.calculation, restrict its generated config to Android, and stage separate project views with each unmodified runtime descriptor. Obtain project digests by bare inspect. Stage exact native archives/materials and original signed offers. Sign a schema-3 diagnostic-only index via the release-tools canonical encoding and regression driver's fresh Ed25519 signer pattern. Put its test anchor outside qualification. Run mixer release inspect against the exact pair and repeat with the successor as installed. Assert exit 2, matching index digest, release.capability-schema and publicationAllowed=false.
replay.verifier: Run mixer-update verify-v3 with the exact packet manifest, payload, host, roots and assignment. Use beta and installation 1f0d30b5-6e05-4e49-b928-a40bc95cb7ce. Check each matching offer, the cross-runtime manifest and assignment, and substitution of the distinct baseline guest.
replay.producer: Call the stock Build.android_contract with AAPT2 on each exact APK and require its installed package-ID refusal. Read AAPT2 effective permission and compiled-manifest output separately and compare the recipe's canonical contract digest with the sealed installed descriptor.

custody.notes: The first verifier wrapper expected a shorter payload error code; the first producer wrapper caught the wrong exception type. Both underlying children returned terminal results. Fresh namespaces reran both with the exact observed values.
custody.cleanup: Removed the exact owned campaign directory after all bounded commands closed, including the source archive, both CLI builds, compiled guests, temporary signing material, staged public input copies and raw logs. Preserved the pre-existing sealed pair and historical read-only inputs.

remaining: Exact-pair stock store-build classification and stock original OTA eligibility remain open. The exact ABI rejection precedes those decisions. Closing both needs supported inspector handling of the original linked ABI and a source-bound calculation-specific producer with distinct signed guests and real matching observations.
